questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ift. hvilke byer jeg kunne vælge på tyskstudiet, kunne Heidelberg tilbyde en mindre by med et stort studiemiljø, hvilket var meget tiltalende.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt. Heidelberg Universitet havde gjort et godt stykke arbejde, med gode guides og to do lister.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ikke andet end den normale administrative hjælp herunder underskrivelse af dokumenter osv.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Vi var heldige, da nogle piger fra et tidligere semester boede i den lejlighed vi overtog. Altså fik vi bolig, da vi kendte nogen. Ellers var det svært at finde housing i Heidelbergm da udbuddet er langt mindre end efterspørgslen.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er ikke så besværligt at komme ind til campus, da de har god regional trafik. Det var rart at kunne adskille skole og privatliv

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg gjorde ikke brug af kollegierne, som Heidelberg Universitet stod for.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Samme proces som på KU - via Mobility.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De havde en Erasmuskoordinator, som stod til rådighed over mail. Fungerede super godt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle dem jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: spørg om hjælp, hvis du ikke forstår det. De er gode til at guide, hvordan deres HeiCo system fungerer.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var højt og professorerne forventede meget af de studerende

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde meget forelæsning i modsætning til på KU, hvor jeg kun har haft holdundervisning.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Internationale Beziehungen Vorlesung

Grundlagen der Europäischen Union

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hvis man har en stor interesse inden for internationale relationer, kan Internationale Beziehungen klart anbefales.

questions.answer: License

questions.answer: mad generelt er billigere i Tyskland. Især frugt og grønt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sportsfaciliteter med mulighed for holdtræning (håndbold, volley, fodbold), musikalske events

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Deres sportsfaciliteter. Deres tilbud om diverse holdsportsmuligheder var mega fede. Man kunne tilmelde sig alt fra håndbold og godbold til basket og volley.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Oplev steder uden for Heidelberg - Mannheim, Karlsruhe, bjergene og de mange gåruter. Frankfurt ligger også kun en time væk. Der er massere af se og opleve.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var lidt svært i starten, men sådan tror jeg det er for mange med nye steder og måder at gøre tingene på. Dog ligner Tyskland og Danmark meget hinanden, så det var ikke den største omvæltning

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Spørg ind til tips de kan give til ting man skal opleve i lokal området. Det er en god måde at komme i kontakt med de lokale studerende på og tyskerne er meget hjælpsomlige, og ønsker gerne at hjælpe.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De er IT-mæssigt ikke lige så langt som vi er i Danmark. Det betød at jeg skulle skaffe fysiske ordbøger til eksamen, samt fuldføre eksamener i hånden. Det var en kulturel forskel. Ellers minder Tyskland meget om Danmark.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Var bare glad for at komme ned og tale tysk igen :)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær åben, hav det sjovt og nyd det. Byen har en god kombination af højt læringsniveau og med plads til at have det sjovt samtidigt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nogle lokale studerende har lavet et fællesskab for udvekslingsstuderende - ESN (European Social Netwerk). De kan findes på Instagram og laver mange sociale arrangementer for nye studerende. God måde at møde andre udvekslingsstuderende på.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At få lov at prøve kræfter med fag, som jeg normalt ikke har adgang til. At jeg havde en frihed til at vælge de valgfalg som tiltalte mig mest.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At starte fra skratch - ikke at have en vennebase på foran.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
